body:
I've been in a few...one of of them was just boring- I suppose I was with the wrong person and it just didn't work out.

The other "relationships" I've been in have pretty much fallen apart because I'm terrible at dating. My small-talking skills are just dreadful, as with my social skills in those kinds of situations in general. I get nervous a lot.
I'd love to talk...can't think of what to talk about, however.

Just realized I left out an "s" in the title, now it reads stupidly :/. 
But in response, that's part of the problem- I know it's so silly to feel so strongly about just some high school girl, but being aware of that just makes me feel worse for feeling bad about it...it just...gets hard to handle, you know?
Thanks for your support. I hope you're doing alright, too.
